### 2026-10-19 – I So Happy Finally Week 2 ended OnShape was so stressful i never felt so stupid while doing something 🥲

**1.6h**

I So Happy Finally Week 2 ended OnShape was so stressful i never felt so stupid while doing something 🥲
well anyway i am building RequiemTone As my week 3 project RequiemTone is basically RequiemTone is a small electronic instrument that lets you play notes, make little melodies, and create retro video-game sounds.

I Will Be using Requiem word for every project ( I am kinda obsessed with it)

So Anyway starting week 3 i created new project in KiCad i added brain of RequiemTone Raspberry Pi Pico
in schematic editor.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/169c07215dff0a3de24e72ceb9c2c94e1ca045ea95a7b371923a38cbfa9464e7.png)

then i added two knobs 10 kΩ potentiometers i don't even know what these do but according to what i found for sound and tempo they are needed so i added 2 of those, plus i added piezo (Conn_01x02) ChatGPT called it a Sounder and i found a new world in my dictionary  Sounder 😂.
i started wiring buttons and added GND on all 8 Buttons i still don't know what it does but lets do it.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/3c043af519980d93b986c4f4de39594d3ae0c84da75f8af17be5c1d20ec410be.png)

And then finally connected piezo  using Device R, i feel for this session its enough as i don't want to see Errors right now.

### 2026-10-20 – I Started Today's Session and it was not very good start 27 Errors WTH!, Then I used Hidden Method I Started Adding X On Unused pins 😅

**2.2h**

I Started Today's Session and it was not very good start 27 Errors WTH!, Then I used Hidden Method I Started Adding X On Unused pins 😅

![Screenshot_20261020_122114](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/b34869179367386cfd3b2420e2826a3e1f8d03f7427b5d9edab169994017aee3.png)

![Screenshot_20261020_122105](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/4708807ed333a242063e93662a4f106ed8352c975f3edc257bd5032ddd1cbd42.png)

And Errors Dropped to 13 🥳 ( Shit still 13 errors ☠️ this should have only left 1 or 2)
Anyway lets start solving real errors

Solving errors i added  +3V3 on 3V3 Pin ,  and added 5 more X marks on
Pin 30 — RUN
Pin 37 — 3V3_EN
Pin 39 — VSYS
Pin 40 — VBUS
Pin 34 — GPIO28_ADC2
Why are these pins even there well nobody cares and errors now dropped to just 5

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/1e17cf704d9e4bf2b8cdde4054e0399b0fde9c0621fd5ec59c2eb2865330ecd6.png)

then i extended the +3V3 wire then took wire from ADC_VERF connected it to middle point of 3V3 wire i have no idea how but somehow errors dropped by 2 then i added GND on AGND pin and all errors solved only last one left , was it always this easy? who knows

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/42d87029fddc1a5efaaf19d2ab68bcda8f789d6f497ce6791e7431bda67dc01a.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/56c2dd4e69ccf738b2f92e91b940660091c4293b7963407256ab6ad404aea929.png)

then i messed up i added PWR Flags on GND PIN and 3V3 and errors somehow increased to 3 the hell, After i removed flags errors got back how to solve this last one.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/09136acf4bdd3a78137f07ab06ab9289638c3fd6c4eb8dc79b80fcf958e53ddb.png)

i checked YouTube asked AI looked at docs still have no idea what do place in GND pin below after doing some more digging in Symbol Editor i changed GND PIN 3 to Power Input instead of power output and errors increased to 3 at least i can understand these errors time for PWR Flags

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/EoZrOkb8W06HhnDij12VcokhR3dPjgAH/8ada85999a832cee65de3a9659de133b0e09433edd1172c92b398d4aeb71fb39.png)
